messages.subject: Link to a tabPanel() page
parts:
Hello,

I am building a shiny app using navbarPage() and tabPanel() and despite all my online research I did not find any reference on how to have an hyperlink across shiny tabPanel().  For example i would like to add some icons on a home page tabPanel("Home",...) that would allow to navigate to another page for example tabPanel("Contact",...).

I am really new at HTML but I tried using bookmark as follow and the link had no effect
HTML("<a id='contact'>Contact</a>") # Create bookmark on the Contact page

HTML("<a href='#contact'>Contact us</a>") # Link to the bookmark on the home page

Thank you in advance!!
